text: An mmseqs prefilter db written with N threads is pdb.0..pdb.N-1 plus one pdb.index of key, offset, length; the offsets run across the files joined in numeric order. Each entry is lines of targetKey, prefilter score, diagonal, sorted by score descending, so line index is rank. nail's qdb_h and tdb_h header dbs give key to name in write order; there is no .lookup.
